edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner on transferOwnership requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to promote ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom reduces allowed[from][msg.sender].
msg.sender's spender contract is invoked by approveAndCall, enabling reentrancy.
onlyOwner on transferAnyERC20Token requires msg.sender == owner.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Charity constructor sets symbol.
Charity constructor sets name.
Charity constructor sets decimals.
Charity constructor sets _totalSupply.
Charity constructor credits the initial holder balance in balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom reads and writes balances for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferAnyERC20Token sends tokens to the privileged owner account.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance, passing untrusted 'tokens'.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance, passing untrusted 'tokens'.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balance and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call before returning.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external transfer on an attacker-supplied token contract.
safeAdd performs the guarded addition c = a + b.
safeSub performs the guarded subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul performs the guarded multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv performs the guarded division c = a / b.
The spender contract's receiveApproval can call back into approveAndCall or transferFrom before state finalization.
The arbitrary token contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token can re-enter the Charity contract.
